items.title: CVE-2026-118498
items.description: The CODESYS Automation Server Connector uses server-supplied file names without sufficient path traversal checks. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious Automation Server and tricking a user to trust it, or performing a man-in-the-middle attack on a trusted communication channel, can exploit this vulnerability to write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary locations on the engineering workstation and subsequently achieve arbitrary code execution with user privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-118497
items.description: The affected products do not sufficiently validate CODESYS Automation Server TLS certificates when a user starts the certificate enrollment. An unauthenticated remote attacker performing a man-in-the-middle attack can exploit this vulnerability by supplying an untrusted certificate that is accepted as trusted. Successful exploitation may allow an attacker to intercept and manipulate communications between the CODESYS Automation Server and the PLC network.

items.title: CVE-2026-118496
items.description: The affected products process a server-supplied URL without sufficient validation. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious Automation Server and tricking a user to trust it or performing a man-in-the-middle attack, can exploit this vulnerability by causing the affected product to process unintended content. Successful exploitation may result in arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the user running the affected product.

items.title: CVE-2026-112209
items.description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability reflected in the GET parameters `cod_primaria` and `cod_secundaria` of the Novanet Web endpoints `NNws_ShwNewDup` and `NPcd/NFG_VerNoticia`. User-provided data is reflected within a JavaScript block without proper sanitization or context-appropriate output encoding. An unauthenticated remote attacker could craft a manipulated URL that, when visited by a victim, would execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the victim’s browser, within the context of the affected site. The flaw resides in the platform’s shared code, so it could affect organizations using that vulnerable code.

items.title: CVE-2026-121865
items.description:
In nanobot, the WebSocket gateway allows a standard client holding a valid client token to select an existing directory outside the operator-configured workspace as the root of a new conversation. The agent can then read and expose files in that directory that are readable by the nanobot service account.

This issue affects nanobot (nanobot-ai) from 0.3.5 before 0.4.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-121864
items.description:
In nanobot, when sandboxed exec is enabled, the shell executable used to run commands can be selected by the caller and is launched before the sandbox is applied. An attacker who can induce the agent to create an executable in the workspace and select it as the shell can cause that executable to run outside the sandbox (e.g. Linux bubblewrap), with the operating-system permissions of the nanobot process.

This issue affects nanobot (nanobot-ai) from 0.2.1 before 0.4.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-119643
items.description: The MembershipWorks - Membership, Events & Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in all versions up to, and including, 6.17. This is due to insufficient output escaping on member-supplied data retrieved from the MembershipWorks SaaS API in the sf_shortcode(), sf_widget_event_do(), and sf_widget_folder_do() functions, where the 'nam' (member name), 'ttl' (event title), 'url', 'adn' (venue name), 'szp', and 'ezp' fields are output into page HTML without escaping, or, in sf_widget_folder_do(), placed in an image alt attribute that an onerror handler copies into innerHTML. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

items.title: CVE-2026-109154
items.description:
In the Matter door lock applications of
  the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on v1.0.0
  through v1.1.1, AccessManager::ValidateCredential() checks only credential
  occupancy and the secret bytes, and never reads the owning user's UserStatus.
  It also returns success when no owning user can be resolved. A user suspended
  by setting their status to OccupiedDisabled can continue to unlock the door
  with their previously assigned credential, and an orphaned but occupied
  credential is also accepted. Fixed in v1.2.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-109151
items.description:
In
the Matter and Aliro Door Lock Application of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door
Lock and Access Control Add-on v1.0.0 through v1.1.1 with
CONFIG_DOOR_LOCK_STEP_UP_PHASE enabled, deleting a Credential Issuer passes the
1-based Matter credential index to ClearValidityIterations(), which expects a
0-based storage index. The intended issuer's ValidityIteration state is left in
place, and the state of the adjacent, still-provisioned issuer is cleared. This
resets that issuer's rollback protection. An attacker holding an older but correctly
signed Access Document from the adjacent issuer, whose validity iteration had
been superseded, can then potentially obtain physical access. Fixed in v1.2.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-109148
items.description:
In the Aliro access control reference
  applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control
  Add-on v1.0.0 through v1.1.1, the stored Access Document record does not
  retain validFrom and validUntil. The cached public key path (VerifyPublicKey())
  and the Kpersistent fast path (_VerifyKPersistentKey()) therefore never
  re-evaluate the Access Document validity period. An attacker who held a
  time-limited Aliro credential that was valid when first presented can
  continue to obtain physical access after the Access Document has expired, for
  as long as the cached record remains available. Fixed in v1.2.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-109138
items.description:
In the Aliro access control reference
  applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control
  Add-on v1.0.0 through v1.1.1, built with Credential Issuer CA
  certificate-based issuer trust (CONFIG_DOOR_LOCK_CREDENTIAL_ISSUER_CA) and
  the Aliro Step-up phase (CONFIG_DOOR_LOCK_STEP_UP_PHASE) enabled,
  AccessManagerImpl::ProcessValidityIteration() treats a failed lookup of the
  Credential Issuer in the provisioned issuer array as success. For an issuer
  trusted through a certificate chain but not provisioned, the
  ValidityIteration (credential-rollback) check is therefore skipped. A former
  authorized holder with an old but correctly issuer-signed Access Document can
  be granted physical access after the issuer has advanced its iteration to
  revoke that credential. The default Matter provisioning configuration is not
  affected. Fixed in v1.2.0.

items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated editors to manipulate search index documents by supplying an arbitrary solutionId to the /admin/api/faq/update endpoint. On Elasticsearch or OpenSearch deployments, category-restricted editors can remove published FAQs from search, overwrite other FAQs' search documents, or plant entries that remain searchable after unpublishing.

items.title: CVE-2026-130382
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in OtpLoginPlugin that allows attackers knowing the database password to skip TOTP verification by abusing the permanent-login cookie. Attackers can submit a login with a wrong OTP and permanent=1 to obtain a neo_permanent cookie, then replay it to gain full authenticated database access.

items.title: CVE-2026-130381
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows language-scoped editors to read other translations by checking FAQ_EDIT against the route language but loading the ?lang= UI-language row. Attackers can request the admin.faq.edit route with an authorized language and a different lang parameter to read drafts, private notes, author e-mails and revisions.

items.title: CVE-2026-130380
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the sqlsrv-based MS SQL driver that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in by submitting an empty username. Attackers can supply any non-empty password, triggering Windows integrated authentication that grants a full session with the web server identity's SQL Server privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-130379
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the privileged-port restriction by injecting separator characters or connection-string keywords into the login server field. Attackers can make pgsql, Mongo, Oracle and PDO drivers parse a different host and port, reaching internal services and leaking limited information through driver responses and errors.

items.title: CVE-2026-130378
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a filter injection vulnerability in its MongoDB driver that allows attackers to affect other documents by embedding ' AND ' or ') OR (' delimiters in a string _id or searched value. Attackers who can store a crafted document can cause a victim's delete or edit to match unintended documents, deleting the entire collection or modifying another document.

items.title: CVE-2026-130377
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in DELETE /admin/api/faq/delete that lets language-scoped FAQ_DELETE admins bypass their language scope. Attackers can submit a faqId with an in-scope faqLanguage lacking a translation to wipe shared ACL, tags, votes, comments, and attachments of other translations.

items.title: CVE-2026-130376
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in FileUploadPlugin that allows database users to store script-bearing SVG files by uploading unsanitized content. Attackers can upload a malicious SVG to a *_path field, executing script in the same-origin session of any administrator who opens the file link.

items.title: CVE-2026-130375
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated SQLite users to bypass the check_sqlite_name() extension guard using PDO_SQLite file: URI database names. Attackers can select the PDO driver with ext=pdo and submit names like file:/webroot/x.php?x=.db to create a .php file, then store PHP source as table data for code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-130374
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL by supplying crafted IN and NOT IN search values that process_length() passes unescaped. Attackers can send a logged-in user a cross-site GET link using a backslash-escaped apostrophe to run blind SQL with that user's database rights on PostgreSQL, SQLite, MS SQL, Oracle, or MySQL in NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES mode.

items.title: CVE-2026-130373
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows database users to inject markup by creating FULLTEXT indexes with crafted names. Attackers with CREATE, ALTER or INDEX rights can store markup rendered unescaped in the selection search form, enabling meta refresh redirects, content spoofing and form tampering against other users.

items.title: CVE-2026-130372
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect authenticated users by injecting an external URL through the HTTP Referer header into the hidden referer field of the edit form. Attackers can lure users from a page with an unsafe-url referrer policy whose URL contains &select=, redirecting them to phishing sites after record edits.

items.title: CVE-2026-130371
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability because the web installer ignores the legacy config/database.php during 3.x upgrades. Unauthenticated attackers can reinstall the site against an attacker-controlled database and create their own administrator account to take over the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-130370
items.description: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows attackers holding a hijacked session to enroll passkeys using only the session and webauthn CSRF token. Attackers can call /api/webauthn/prepare and /api/webauthn/register to replace the owner's passkeys, gaining persistent passwordless login that survives password changes and resets.

items.title: CVE-2026-130369
items.description: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in multisite deployments that allows attackers to overwrite passkeys of accounts on other tenants via a shared PHP session store. Attackers can run WebAuthn prepare() for a login on one tenant, then replay the session against /api/webauthn/register on another tenant or the master to replace that user's passkeys and log in as admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-130368
items.description: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts vulnerability in PasswordChangeController::update() that bypasses the step-up throttle. Attackers holding a hijacked admin-area session can repeatedly guess faqpassword_old with a reusable CSRF token to learn the original password and take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-130367
items.description: phpMyFAQ through 4.1.12 and from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the admin FAQ copy and translate pages, which check only global FAQ_ADD or FAQ_TRANSLATE rights. Authenticated add-only or category-scoped editors can open any FAQ to read drafts, ACL-restricted records, private notes, and author e-mail addresses.

items.title: CVE-2026-130366
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver that allows remote attackers to log in to passwordless accounts without the configured defaultPasswordHash password. Attackers who know the name of a ClickHouse no_password account can submit any non-empty password, because connect() skips openPasswordless(), and obtain a session with that account's rights.

items.title: CVE-2026-130365
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows FAQ_EDIT users to bypass SvgSanitizer using namespace-prefixed elements like <x:script>. Attackers can upload malicious SVGs through the admin image upload so script runs in the site origin on IIS, hijacking sessions of users like super-admins.

items.title: CVE-2026-130364
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a reflected HTML injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject markup by supplying crafted array keys in the where URL parameter. Attackers can trick logged-in users into opening a link whose unescaped keys land in select search form name attributes, enabling meta refresh redirects and content spoofing.

items.title: CVE-2026-130363
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets scoped editors view out-of-scope draft FAQs because the dashboard and admin search ignore category/language-scoped FAQ_EDIT rights. Authenticated editors can load the unpublished FAQs widget with the lang parameter or query /admin/api/faq/search to leak draft titles, ids, and confirm words in draft bodies.

items.title: CVE-2026-130362
items.description: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an account enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid logins through differing POST /api/webauthn/prepare responses. Attackers can submit wordlists of usernames, reusing one unconsumed CSRF token without rate limiting, to discover administrator logins for password spraying and phishing.

items.title: CVE-2026-130361
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a parameter injection vulnerability in its ClickHouse driver that allows attackers to inject ClickHouse HTTP query parameters through an unencoded db GET parameter. Attackers can lure a logged-in victim into opening a crafted GET link that injects a query parameter, bypassing the POST-only CSRF token. ClickHouse then executes attacker-chosen SQL under the victim's credentials to read, modify, or drop data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130360
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in EditorNeo that allows remote attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting quote characters into the request URI. Attackers can lure authenticated users to crafted edit links whose path breaks out of the CSP-nonced whisper script in editor/core/Admin.php, enabling session theft and database credential disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-130359
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in SlugifyEditPlugin::getFieldInput() that embeds column names unescaped in an inline initSlugField() call. Attackers with DDL privileges can create a slug column whose name contains a single quote, injecting JavaScript that runs under the page's CSP nonce when victims open the table's edit form.

items.title: CVE-2026-130358
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the ClaudeSqlPlugin, GeminiSqlPlugin, and OpenWebUiPlugin sendHeaders() handlers that run on the login page. Unauthenticated attackers can POST claude, gemini, or openwebui fields to relay arbitrary prompts using the operator's API key or bearer token, including to internal Open WebUI endpoints.

items.title: CVE-2026-130357
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in updateUserRights that lets USER_EDIT admins drop category restrictions on group rights. Attackers can re-save rights through the user update-rights API to convert category-restricted group rights into global direct rights, then edit, publish or delete FAQs in withheld categories.

items.title: CVE-2026-130356
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass that lets category- or language-restricted editors rewrite visibility ACLs and tags of any FAQ. Attackers send faq/update requests with a target faqId and an untranslated lang to expose restricted FAQs, wipe tags, or overwrite orphaned FAQs.

items.title: CVE-2026-130355
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in POST /admin/api/faq/import that lets FAQ_ADD users bypass the FAQ_PUBLISH right. Authenticated contributors can upload a CSV with column 8 set to true to publish unreviewed, optionally sticky FAQs such as phishing content.

items.title: CVE-2026-130354
items.description: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in POST /api/webauthn/prepare that creates accounts as active, bypassing manual activation and domain whitelisting. Anonymous attackers can obtain the freely issued CSRF token and register an activated account with an unverified email to access registered-user-only content and functions.

items.title: CVE-2026-130353
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its public FAQ REST API that exposes author names and e-mail addresses to unauthenticated callers. Attackers can query the faq and paginated faqs endpoints to bulk-harvest e-mails and de-anonymise users who opted out of GDPR author visibility.

items.title: CVE-2026-130352
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read editor-only Private Notes by querying the public FAQ list API. Attackers can page through GET /api/v4.0/faqs or /api/v3.1/faqs without credentials to retrieve the notes field of every anonymously readable FAQ, exposing internal remarks and ticket details.

items.title: CVE-2026-130351
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the multisite Redis configuration store that is not tenant-scoped. As a result, tenant administrators can read and overwrite the master instance's effective configuration. Attackers can save configuration through /admin/api/configuration, optionally resetting storage.redisPrefix, to redirect master SMTP, set a known API token, or alter authentication settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-130350
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated group or user admins to remove rights they do not hold by submitting empty rights lists. Attackers can send an empty rightIds or userRights array to group/permissions or user/update-rights to wipe all rights of more-privileged groups or administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-130349
items.description: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows category- or language-restricted editors to bypass scoped rights via public REST write endpoints. Attackers with a scoped right and the shared API token can use PUT faq/update, POST faq/create, and POST category to rewrite published FAQs and create root categories outside their scope.

items.title: CVE-2026-130348
items.description: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that exposes restricted and inactive category metadata to unauthenticated visitors. Attackers can enumerate category IDs via /category/{id}/{slug}.html or query /api/v4.0/categories to read names, descriptions, images and FAQ counts of restricted categories.

items.title: CVE-2026-130347
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass in password reset, letting external-identity accounts receive local passwords. Attackers with mailbox access can request reset tokens for OIDC, Keycloak, Entra ID, LDAP, SSO, or WebAuthn accounts and log in locally, skipping IdP MFA and deprovisioning.

items.title: CVE-2026-130346
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver because idf_escape() doubles backticks but does not escape backslashes in identifiers. Attackers can lure a logged-in user into opening a GET link with a column name ending in a backslash in columns, where, or order parameters, causing query text to be parsed as SQL.

items.title: CVE-2026-130345
items.description: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated frontend users to receive restricted FAQ titles by subscribing to Web Push notifications. When editors publish user/group-restricted FAQs, WebPushService::sendToAll() delivers the question, FAQ id, category, and slugified URL to every subscriber, bypassing the FAQ ACL.

items.title: CVE-2026-130344
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Admin::printTablePartitions() that allows authenticated users to inject HTML by placing markup in partition column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privileges can create a partitioned table whose unescaped partition expression executes script when another user opens the table-structure page.

items.title: CVE-2026-130343
items.description: phpMyFAQ 3.2.5 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the user/request-removal API endpoint that lets authenticated users file account removal requests as other users. The ownership check calls getUserById() with the attacker-supplied userId on the session user object, so it compares the input against the target's own record. Attackers who know a victim's login name and email can submit that userId, loginname, and email, sending administrators a spoofed Remove User Request email. This may lead an admin to delete the victim's account and data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130342
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper reference counting flaw on multisite deployments, allowing editors to delete other instances' attachment files. Because linkedRecords() counts only the local faqattachment table, deleting an attachment with shared md5 content makes File::delete() unlink the shared blob, destroying another instance's files.

items.title: CVE-2026-130341
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject javascript: links via FAQ comments. When the comment editor is enabled, Utils::parseUrl() strips https:// from sanitized hrefs, turning an allowed https://javascript:443/ link into executable script that runs on the shared admin origin when clicked.

items.title: CVE-2026-130340
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows database users to inject markup into another user's session via column type names rendered with innerHTML. Attackers can create a PostgreSQL type or table with markup in its name to render live elements in the help popup, enabling content spoofing and requests to attacker servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-130339
items.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read unpublished FAQ titles via bookmark_action. Attackers can request FAQ detail pages with bookmark_action=add across sequential ids, then view /user/bookmarks to reveal draft and pending submission question text.

items.title: CVE-2026-130338
items.description: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored sql injection vulnerability in the MySQL driver that allows database users with table creation rights to inject SQL through unescaped geometry column names in unconvert_field(). Attackers can craft a column name containing an SQL expression that executes with another AdminNeo user's privileges when they edit a row, save it, or export the table.

items.title: CVE-2026-12487
items.description: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in the SNMP parameter of Zyxel EE5301-00 customized firmware version 5.63(ACLD.2)b3_D0 could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition on an affected device.

items.title: CVE-2026-130335
items.description: Info-ZIP Zip 3.0 (and 3.1 beta through 3.1c) allows OS command injection by an attacker who controls the command line. The victim must use the -T option followed by a filename containing shell metacharacters, on a platform (such as Linux) where a suitable shell is run. This occurs because the system C library function is used. NOTE: there is no known common scenario in which an untrusted filename reaches a zip -T call.

items.description: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI relies on a world-writable /tmp file unless XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set, or localhost TCP port 10010, allowing RXAPI communication by any local user, e.g., for injection of a macro that will be executed by a REXX script.

items.description: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI mishandles nameArg and userid bounds checking, possibly leading to arbitrary code execution via crafted messages.

items.description: The Coder VS Code extension opens Coder workspaces in VS Code with a single click. From 0.1.20 until 1.14.6, a malicious repository can provide .vscode/settings.json values for security-sensitive Coder settings because the extension permits workspace and folder scope to override those settings. items.title: CVE-2026-68934
items.description: code-review-mcp-server automates code review and can post comments directly on GitHub pull requests. Prior to 1.5.3, the getLocalGitDiff, codeReview, createPR, and getPRTemplate MCP tools accept caller-controlled folderPath and baseBranch string parameters that are interpolated into command strings executed by child_process.execSync through /bin/sh. Shell metacharacters, command substitution, or quote-breaking input can therefore execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the host process running the MCP server. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-130290
items.description: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI has a heap buffer over-read in a QueueManager DataQueue::addmethod. In particular, the code blindly trusts the message.parameter1 value provided by the client as the size used to fill the data from the queueData heap buffer. An attacker sends a large parameter1 value in an ADD_TO_SESSION_QUEUE or ADD_TO_NAMED_QUEUE message and then retrieves data with a PULL_FROM_SESSION_QUEUE message. (A very large value causes a process crash.)

items.title: CVE-2026-130206
items.description: Chyrp Lite (xenocrat/chyrp-lite) contains a missing brute-force protection vulnerability in the main_login() function that allows remote attackers to repeatedly submit login attempts against the admin account without any attempt counter, lockout, delay, or CAPTCHA enforcement. items.title: CVE-2026-130083
items.description: BookStack before 26.09.2 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the ZIP content importer that allows authenticated users with the Import Content permission to exhaust server storage. Attackers can upload a small ZIP whose data.json references one bundled file many times, causing ZipImportRunner::importAttachment() to write a full copy per reference.

items.title: CVE-2026-130082
items.description: django-tenants 3.4.8 before 4.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its PostgreSQL backend that allows attackers to inject SQL through unescaped tenant schema names. Attackers who can choose or influence a schema name can supply quote characters that are interpolated into SET search_path and CREATE, DROP or ALTER SCHEMA statements, letting them read other tenants' data or run SQL as the application's database user.

items.title: CVE-2026-130081
items.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain article view passwords by querying the public GET /articles API. The ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage handler leaves the articleViewPwd property in JSON responses, letting attackers read passwords for encrypted articles and access their protected content.

items.title: CVE-2026-130080
items.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the console article update API that allows authenticated authors to inject SQL through unvalidated JSON property names. Attackers can send a PUT request to /console/article/ with crafted property names used as UPDATE column names, then read query results back through the updated article.

items.title: CVE-2026-130079
items.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject script by setting a malicious article title rendered without escaping. Attackers can set titles, including via the B3 sync endpoint, so admin/article-pwd.ftl, skin templates, and js/page.js article lists execute script in visitors' and administrators' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-130078
items.description: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in B3Receiver.receiveArticle that allows visitor accounts to modify any article via the POST /apis/symphony/article endpoint. items.title: CVE-2026-130077
items.description: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal hosts via caller-controlled proxy and proxy_list fields in /v1/scrape. Attackers can supply proxy entries pointing to loopback, private-network or link-local hosts, bypassing page URL checks to open HTTP-proxy or SOCKS connections internally.

items.title: CVE-2026-130076
items.description: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by supplying an unvalidated baseUrl to the /v1/scrape endpoint. items.title: CVE-2026-130075
items.description: SplitPro through 2.1.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the addOrEditExpense and addOrEditCurrencyConversion tRPC mutations that allows authenticated users to assign expenses to arbitrary users. items.title: CVE-2026-130074
items.description: free5GC WebConsole through 1.4.6 contains an authorization flaw in the ChangePasswordInfo handler that allows authenticated tenant users to change other members' passwords. Attackers can send POST /api/change-password with another tenant member's email and a new password, without the current password, to take over that account.

items.title: CVE-2026-130073
items.description: CBoard before commit 7bd8180 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to reach admin functions because AdminController and DashboardController methods bypass AOP role checks. Attackers with no role grants can call deleteUser, deleteRole, getUserList, getAllWidgetList and getAllDatasetList to read query configurations and delete accounts including the administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-130072
items.description: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130071
items.description: TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify any document. items.title: CVE-2026-130070
items.description: Ghost by muneeb141 on the main branch from commit c731cdf through commit 672dfec contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the whitelisted ghost.api.ghost.convert_to_real_user method that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip OTP verification by setting the client-supplied bypass_otp parameter. Attackers can obtain a ghost session from the guest-accessible create_ghost_session endpoint, then call convert_to_real_user with an arbitrary real_email and bypass_otp=1 to receive OAuth tokens for existing accounts and take them over.

items.title: CVE-2026-130069
items.description: Frappe Framework before 15.123.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the frappe.email.email_body.get_email_html method, which lacks role checks. Authenticated users, including portal Website Users, can inject stylesheet link tags into unescaped email templates, causing Premailer to fetch internal or external hosts and return the content.

items.title: CVE-2026-130068
items.description: Umbraco CMS 17.0.0 before 17.7.1 and 18.0.0 before 18.2.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Management API document version endpoints that skip per-document ContentPermissionByResource checks. items.title: CVE-2026-130067
items.description: 7-Zip File Manager before 26.03 fails to detect archive entry names padded with Unicode space characters, allowing attackers to bypass the deceptive file name warning in CPanel::IsVirus_Message. items.title: CVE-2026-130066
items.description: Alinto SOGo before 5.12.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in SQLSource contact lookup that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by placing a backslash before a quote in the object name. Attackers can send requests under a SQL-backed address book path on MySQL or MariaDB to perform UNION or boolean-based reads of the user-source table, including password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-130065
items.description: msgpack-c through 7.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in msgpack_vrefbuffer_migrate() in src/vrefbuffer.c that checks capacity against the source array's end pointer. items.title: CVE-2026-130064
items.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_command_del() that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed memory through aliased XMT-A SFCommandBuffer command ownership. items.title: CVE-2026-130063
items.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via discarded nodes left on the parser node stack. items.title: CVE-2026-130062
items.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_node_get_tag() that allows attackers to crash the process via crafted XMT connect elements. Attackers can supply an XMT scene file whose connect element has a parent with no node, crashing MP4Box during processing and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-130061
items.description: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in gf_sg_sfcommand_del() that allows attackers to crash the process via crafted XMT scenes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/MP4 file where a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer references a command freed twice during scene teardown, causing MP4Box to crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-129190
items.description: A vulnerability in the Phison SSD controller firmware Phison E12; ECFM32.2 allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to bypass the "Security Access" handshake by leveraging leaked RSA parameters found in vendor utility binaries. Because the firmware's code regions lack protection, these primitives can be used to overwrite existing handlers and achieve volatile code execution on the SSD controller.

items.title: CVE-2026-127219
items.description: WPChat plugin for WordPress before 1.4.6 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to invoke the admin claim-offer action by reusing the publicly exposed wpchat_frontend nonce without any capability check. items.title: CVE-2026-123353
items.description: Docmost is open-source collaborative wiki and documentation software. Prior to 0.96.0, two concurrent role-demotion requests from a space admin or workspace owner can each pass the last-admin or last-owner count check before either update is committed because the validation and role update are not serialized in one transaction. The requests can therefore demote the final two space admins or workspace owners and leave the affected space without an admin or the workspace without an owner, preventing normal administrative recovery. This issue is fixed in version 0.96.0.

The attacker can use users.disableTFA to clear the same target's tfaIsActive state and TFA secret without a target-privilege check, then authenticate with the replacement password. Supplying groups: [] to users.update can remove every group relationship from a selected administrator and leave the installation without a legitimate account holding manage:system. items.title: CVE-2026-120697
items.description: Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. Prior to 2.5.315, an authenticated user with write:pages can store JavaScript expressions in the v-slot:tabs or v-slot:content attributes of page HTML because server/modules/rendering/html-security/renderer.js adds those executable Vue directives to DOMPurify's allowlist. The sanitized output is inserted as rendered page HTML and later compiled by the Vue 2 runtime compiler, so the expressions execute in the Wiki.js origin when another user views the page even when the author lacks write:scripts and administrative permissions. The script runs with the viewer's browser session and can read same-origin data, modify displayed content, present phishing content, or perform actions available to that viewer, including privileged GraphQL operations when a privileged user opens the page. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.315.

items.title: CVE-2026-115846
items.description: The Libreswan IKEv2 state machine did not verify that an IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange was required to satisfy the addke= PostQuantum algorithm component of the exchange. A connecting client could (maliciously or by implementation error) skip the IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange and start an IKE_AUTH exchange prematurely. The result is as if the addke= option had not been specified, and such connections are only protected by the classic key exchange algorithm (such as P-256 or Curve25519), allowing "store now, decrypt later" attacks once a quantum computer becomes available. Only connections with the addke= keyword in the ike= and/or esp= configuration option are affected. PostQuantum Hybrid Key Exchange support was added in version 5.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-110339
items.description: The Libreswan pluto daemon dereferences a NULL pointer when a CERT payload is received with an empty PKCS#7 payload, causing the daemon to crash and restart. The NSS function SEC_PKCS7GetCertificateList() was used to check whether the content was empty, but this check did not trigger if the non-empty content of the PKCS#7 wrapped payload was an empty list. Continued triggering of this vulnerability can lead to a denial of service. Remote code execution is not possible. Authentication is not required to trigger this vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2025-71471
items.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a use of uninitialized memory vulnerability in stbl_AddCTS() that allows attackers to corrupt sample table data via crafted MP4 files. Attackers can supply an MP4 with out-of-order composition time offsets for MP4Box import, triggering invalid memory access in gf_list_get() and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-77597
items.description: iSponsorBlockTV is a SponsorBlock client for YouTube TV clients. Prior to 2.11.0, src/iSponsorBlockTV/dial_client.py trusts the SSDP LOCATION URL supplied by a local-network responder without validating its destination. During automatic discovery, this can cause an attacker-directed GET request and a constrained POST request to a path ending in /YouTube; the POST uses application-defined headers and an application-defined payload rather than attacker-selected request contents. The requests can reach internal services, but the detailed request behavior states that response data and errors are not returned to the attacker, making the demonstrated behavior blind SSRF with bounded integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 2.11.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-76823
items.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260706.0, the logsWorkerConfig GraphQL query is authorized with the broad CONNECTORAPI capability and returns Elasticsearch connection details including elasticsearch_username, elasticsearch_password, elasticsearch_api_key, the URL, index, proxy, and TLS-verification setting. A holder of any connector API bearer token can retrieve this credential material. If the returned credentials are valid and Elasticsearch is reachable, the caller can directly read, modify, or delete OpenCTI indices and audit history outside application-layer role, marking, organization, and audit controls, with the practical impact bounded by the credentials' privileges and network reachability. This issue is fixed in version 7.260706.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-76822
items.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260701.0, the caseIncidentAdd, caseRfiAdd, and caseRftAdd GraphQL mutations require only authentication and do not require a capability check. An authenticated user with reader-level permissions can therefore create incident, request-for-information, and request-for-takedown case objects regardless of the user's assigned role, causing unauthorized changes to platform data. This issue is fixed in version 7.260701.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-71306
items.description: Mikochi is a minimalist file manager with streaming capabilities. Prior to 1.10.1, authenticated users of bare-metal instances configured with a non-default trailing-slash DATA_DIR can use the Move endpoint to supply traversal-containing source or destination paths. The affected path validation can resolve those paths outside the configured data directory, allowing files to be written beyond Mikochi's intended storage boundary. Docker deployments that confine the data directory to a mounted volume and configurations whose DATA_DIR lacks a trailing slash are not affected by the described attack. items.title: CVE-2026-57151
items.description: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. From 11.0.0 until 11.0.10 and 12.0.1, an authenticated technician can modify the two-factor authentication security of a user with higher privileges because the affected operations do not enforce all required authorization checks for the target user. items.title: CVE-2026-57150
items.description: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. items.description:
Improper restriction of intended endpoints in the connection configuration handling of the AWS Labs Timestream for InfluxDB MCP Server (awslabs.timestream-for-influxdb-mcp-server) before 0.0.19 might allow a remote unauthenticated actor (via prompt injection) to obtain the InfluxDB API token configured on the server, sent to a crafted endpoint controlled through an InfluxDB URL introduced in the MCP client context.

items.title: CVE-2026-124017
items.description: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-patch tuples into the unsigned, CRC-protected flash ID page read by the BootROM. By overwriting a fuse-derived RAM variable via a crafted patch entry using Phison Vendor Specific Commands, an attacker can force CRC-only firmware verification instead of signature checking, enabling an unsigned firmware image to load and creating a persistent controller-level implant that survives firmware reinstallation and operates below the host operating system.

items.title: CVE-2026-121708
items.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260513.0, Draft Workspace identifiers are accepted without verifying that the authenticated user can access the referenced draft. Any authenticated user can enumerate draftWorkspaces, use a disclosed DRAFT_ID with draftWorkspaceEntities to read unpublished reports, descriptions, observables, and other staged intelligence, or place the identifier in the opencti-draft-id header and run mutations that inject entities and relationships into another user's private workspace. items.title: CVE-2026-120699
items.description: CubeSandbox is an instant, concurrent, secure, and lightweight sandbox for AI agents. Prior to 0.5.1, any authenticated tenant permitted to call POST /sandboxes can supply metadata["host-mount"] with an arbitrary existing host path because the control plane performs no authorization check or allowed-prefix validation for the path. injectHostDirMounts forwards the path to prepareHostDirVolume, where Cubelet uses mount --rbind through the function to perform a recursive bind mount as root and exposes the host subtree to the tenant's MicroVM through virtio-fs, read-write by default. This allows host-root file access and modification, host code execution, access to the container runtime, and compromise of co-resident tenants without a kernel or virtual-machine-monitor flaw. This issue is fixed in version 0.5.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-114505
items.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260722.0, the GraphQL endpoint accepts query operations over HTTP GET because CSRF prevention is disabled (csrfPrevention: false), placing the complete GraphQL query and its arguments in the request URL. Server and reverse-proxy logs, browser history, and shared caches can retain sensitive filters, marking-restricted identifiers, and investigation search arguments, allowing a person with access to those records to recover legitimate users' query contents. GraphQL mutations are not accepted over GET, and the issue does not permit code execution. This issue is fixed in version 7.260722.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-111760
items.description: Git is a fast, scalable, distributed revision control system with an unusually rich command set that provides both high-level operations and full access to internals. Prior to 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1, an attacker-controlled repository hosted by the attacker rather than on a normal forge site can exploit git clone --recurse-submodules by causing Git to overwrite a submodule gitfile with a symbolic link. The symbolic link can point to a directory containing attacker-controlled Git configuration or hooks, allowing those hooks or configuration to execute code on the cloning user's system. The issue requires the recursive-submodule option, and users should avoid cloning repositories from untrusted sources. This issue is fixed in versions 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1, and 2.56.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-104840
items.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260428.0, the token GraphQL mutation used for primary login has no endpoint-specific rate limit, while the global Express limiter defaults to permitting 10,000 requests in a one-second window. An unauthenticated remote attacker can make password guesses at network speed against a chosen user account and, if a credential is recovered, access the account's threat-intelligence data and permitted operations. This issue is fixed in version 7.260428.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-104258
items.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. The request can target internal services or cloud metadata endpoints that are reachable from the server, enabling server-side request forgery without waiting for a notifier event. items.title: CVE-2026-104253
items.description: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260715.0, a ProfileQuery response can expose the user's TOTP MFA secret after activation. A person who can access the profile response can recover the secret, enroll a duplicate authenticator, and generate valid one-time codes, undermining the account's second-factor protection. items.title: CVE-2026-102892

items.title: CVE-2026-95839

items.title: CVE-2026-45016
items.description: EGroupware is a web-based groupware server written in PHP. Prior to 23.1.20260601 and 26.5.20260507, the processURL2InlineImages logic in api/src/Mail.php treats non-HTTP image sources in an HTML mail body as local paths and passes a decoded attacker-controlled file:// URI to file_get_contents. Any authenticated user with mail access can cause files readable by the web server process to be embedded as inline MIME attachments in outgoing email, exposing local configuration, credentials, private keys, or other server files. This issue is fixed in versions 23.1.20260601 and 26.5.20260507.

items.title: CVE-2026-129304
items.description: Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 1.0.0 until 3.13.0, _extract_from_forwarded_header() in guard_core/utils.py returns the selected X-Forwarded-For entry without validating that it is an IP address. In deployments configured with trusted_proxies where the selected entry is attacker-controlled, the arbitrary client_ip string reaches BehaviorTracker in guard_core/handlers/behavior_handler.py and is interpolated into Redis key names and blocking KEYS glob patterns. Glob metacharacters can cause one request to count other clients' behavior events, embedded separators can disturb key parsing, and rotating identities can create unbounded keys while repeatedly scanning the shared Redis keyspace. A non-IP identity can also reach a ban action and cause an uncaught validation error. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-129303
items.description: Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 1.0.0 until 3.13.0, ContentPreprocessor.preprocess() in guard_core/detection_engine/preprocessor.py collapses all whitespace before built-in pattern matching in the default enhanced mode. This removes carriage returns and newlines required by the http_split and newline-anchored cmd_injection detectors in guard_core/handlers/suspatterns_handler.py, making those detectors unable to match. Framework-decoded CRLF can therefore pass through Guard Core unflagged while the downstream application still receives the raw newline-bearing value. Direct security impact requires a downstream stack or application that persists or re-emits the value into a CRLF-tolerant response or command context. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-129302
items.description: Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 3.5.0 until 3.13.0, built-in penetration-detection patterns in guard_core/handlers/suspatterns_handler.py execute through a direct pattern.search(content) call instead of the timeout-protected create_safe_matcher() path used for custom patterns. The built-in template-injection detector contains an unbounded expression with quadratic behavior when scanning repeated opening braces. Because penetration detection and enhanced mode are enabled by a stock SecurityConfig, an unauthenticated request can block the shared asyncio event loop, affecting all application endpoints. The triggering input does not produce a detection match, so the request can complete without incrementing ban counters or being recorded as suspicious. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-87027
items.description: In EDB Postgres Extended Server and EDB Postgres Advanced Server versions 15 through 18 with Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled, the key used to encrypt temporary files was incompletely initialized. items.title: CVE-2026-83817
items.description: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, DEFAULT_AUTOMATION_AUTO_APPROVE caused AutomationRecord::task_auto_approve to resolve an omitted setting to true, and the automation_create schema advertised the same insecure default. enqueue_run_task converted that omission into an explicit true value, bypassing the safer task-path fallback and selecting ApprovalMode::Bypass for each scheduled run. After a user approved creation of an apparently benign recurring automation, subsequent executions could silently authorize mutating tools without a human present, and an automation created with shell access could repeatedly execute commands. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-83816
items.description: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, the ExecShellTool::approval_requirement_for path used is_parallel_readonly_command to downgrade commands to automatic approval based on a flag-stripped command allowlist. The allowlist treated fd, rg, and git grep as read-only even when fd -x or fd --exec, rg --pre, or git grep --open-files-in-pager selected an external program. registered_tool_approval_required returned without displaying a prompt for that automatic classification, and the later command-safety check also treated the base utilities as safe. Attacker-controlled content that influenced an agent tool call could therefore cause arbitrary program execution on the developer host without the approval promised by the default interactive profile, resulting in unauthorized access, modification, or disruption. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-129307
items.description: eml_parser serves as a python module for parsing eml files and returning various information found in the e-mail as well as computed information. In 3.0.3 and earlier, eml_parser.routing.parserouting() in eml_parser/routing.py builds a regular expression with multiple greedy capture groups and appends the npdate date literal extracted from a normalized copy of an attacker-controlled Received header, then searches that expression against the original unnormalized line. A formatting difference can make the trailing literal impossible to match, causing exhaustive backtracking across the greedy groups at each start position. The unsliced Received-header path is invoked by decode_email, decode_email_bytes, and parse_email, so one small unauthenticated message can pin a parser worker and create sustained queue backlog. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.4.
